title: Adjusted gross income — the Brennans
instructions: Compute the Brennans' 2025 AGI. They file jointly; neither is covered by a workplace retirement plan; both are under 50. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Income
exhibits.content:
Wages: **$95,000**
Taxable interest: **$1,500**
Schedule C net profit (Mia): **$20,000**
Net capital loss: **$(8,000)**

exhibits.title: Possible adjustments
exhibits.content:
- Half of Mia's SE tax: **$1,413**
- Traditional IRA contribution (Liam): **$7,000**
- HSA contribution (family HDHP): **$4,300**
- Student loan interest paid: **$2,800** (MAGI below the phaseout)
- Liam's unreimbursed classroom supplies (he's a K-12 teacher): **$400**

rows.label: Capital loss allowed against ordinary income
rows.explanation: Limited to **3,000** on a joint return.
